item.title: Cenobamate Impact on Cognition in Tuberous Sclerosis Complex
item.description: In adults with tuberous sclerosis complex, add-on cenobamate improved executive function, quality of life, and stress. The post Cenobamate Impact on Cognition in Tuberous Sclerosis Complex appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: MRI Radiomics May Help Stratify Rectal Cancer Risk
item.description: MRI-based radiomics models may help predict tumour deposit burden in rectal cancer, with a fusion AI approach outperforming radiologists in preoperative risk assessment. The post MRI Radiomics May Help Stratify Rectal Cancer Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Ramadan Fasting Reveals What Sustains Change in Dietary Behavior
item.description: Ramadan fasting interviews highlight how values, social support, and habits can sustain short-term dietary behavior change. The post Ramadan Fasting Reveals What Sustains Change in Dietary Behavior appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Novel Non-Invasive Liver Fibrosis Tests Are Effective Biopsy Alternatives
item.description: Novel non-invasive liver disease assessments (NILDAs) are effective liver biopsy alternatives for fibrosis, a 2026 systematic review has found. The post Novel Non-Invasive Liver Fibrosis Tests Are Effective Biopsy Alternatives appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Charcoal Grilling Smoke Shows Very High Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons
item.description: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in charcoal grill smoke reached extreme levels during pork belly cooking, researchers report. The post Charcoal Grilling Smoke Shows Very High Polycyclic Aromatic Hydrocarbons appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Antimicrobial Resistance Threatens Children Across Oceania
item.description: Drug-resistant infections such as MRSA are widespread among children in Oceania, with major gaps in access and approved treatments. The post Antimicrobial Resistance Threatens Children Across Oceania appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Menstrual Blood Shows Promise as Alternative Sample for HPV Screening
item.description: HPV testing using menstrual blood showed comparable accuracy to clinician-collected samples in detecting high-grade cervical lesions in a large population study. The post Menstrual Blood Shows Promise as Alternative Sample for HPV Screening appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: PM2.5 Pollution Driven by Residential Wood Burning
item.description: Residential wood burning contributes substantially to winter PM2.5 pollution in the USA, linked to thousands of premature deaths. The post PM2.5 Pollution Driven by Residential Wood Burning appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: New Research into Oral Semaglutide and Heart Failure Outcomes
item.description: The secondary SOUL trial analysis shows oral semaglutide reduces heart failure events in patients with diabetes and pre-existing heart failure. The post New Research into Oral Semaglutide and Heart Failure Outcomes appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Personalised T Cell Activator Shows Promise
item.description: A personalised multipeptide T cell activator induced durable immune responses and showed an acceptable safety profile in patients with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia in a phase one trial. The post Personalised T Cell Activator Shows Promise appeared first on European Medical Journal.
